text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! It's Kiseki! Kiseki has taken the 
lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Carving out the ultimate trajectory 
toward victory! She is etching it into 
history right nowーーーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You're incredible, Kiseki...! Pushing 
through this kind of lineup with that 
running style...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...We might actually do it. We might 
actually win! Ahahaha! Gooooo, Kiseki—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Claiming the Grand Prix crown is Kiseki! 
Kiseki finishes in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Kiseki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You... I knew you were incredible after 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Fight me again! Race with me! ————It's a 
promise!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—...! That's it! Look right at me with 
those eyes, Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promise! Let us continue this contest! A 
true creator must entertain you as well!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Making everyone who witnesses it yearn to 
see what's 'next.' Making everyone 
anticipate a run that surpasses itself!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is my—masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Until the very moment these legs stop 
running, I'll paint my canvas to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My "trajectory" that will captivate 
everyone who sees it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No further words could be found. She had 
returned to write her story once more."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that 'best' of mine is getting 
surpassed by me tomorrow anyway!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because together, we can reach it! Beyond 
reality, beyond fiction—to what lies 
ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's go towards a future no one has ever 
seen! We'll create an ending that belongs 
only to us, constantly reaching new 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because if it's with you, we can create 
it!!
